closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, carb quality, and calcium, but the biggest weaknesses are saturated fat, low vitamin A, and low magnesium. It's good for bone health, immune support, and practical meals because calcium can support bones, vitamin A and zinc help support the immune system, and it's easy to build meals around.
